zh.siteTagline: AI 智能跳绳 · 数据记录
zh.heroTitle: AI 智能跳绳教练，陪你每一次训练
zh.heroDesc: 小树跳绳不止是记录工具，更是你的 AI 智能跳绳教练。无论新手还是健身爱好者，都能获得专业的运动指导与数据分析。
zh.downloadCta: 在 iOS App Store 中搜索「小树跳绳」下载
zh.featuresSubtitle: AI 分析 · 多设备记录 · 精准追踪
zh.featureAIDesc: 通过人工智能算法深度解析跳绳数据，精准评估运动状态，量身定制训练计划与改进建议。
zh.featureMultiDesc: 支持手机与 Apple Watch 记录跳绳数据，无需繁琐连接，随时随地捕捉运动瞬间，数据同步高效准确。
zh.featureDataDesc: 实时记录跳绳数量、时间、热量消耗等关键数据，每日训练详情清晰呈现，AI 加持的每日汇总看板直观展现运动趋势。
zh.featureCoachDesc: 根据你的数据与目标，提供针对性的训练建议，减肥塑形、提升体能少走弯路。
zh.aboutDesc: 小树跳绳致力于让跳绳训练更科学、更有趣。借助 AI 分析与多设备协同，让每一次跳跃都有据可查、有据可依。
zh.disclaimerText: 本应用提供的训练建议仅供参考，请根据自身身体状况合理安排运动强度。

en.heroTitle: Your AI Jump Rope Coach, Every Session
en.heroDesc: Treelet Skip is more than a counter—it's your AI jump rope coach. Whether you're new or experienced, get professional guidance and data-driven insights.
en.downloadCta: Search "Treelet Skip" in the iOS App Store to download
en.featureAIDesc: Deep analysis of your jump rope data with AI; accurate assessment of your performance and personalized training plans and tips.
en.featureMultiDesc: Record with iPhone or Apple Watch; no complicated setup. Sync data quickly and accurately wherever you train.
en.featureDataDesc: Real-time count, duration, and calories; clear daily summaries and an AI-enhanced dashboard to track progress and trends.
en.featureCoachDesc: Training advice tailored to your data and goals—whether you're losing weight or building fitness.
en.aboutDesc: Treelet Skip makes jump rope training smarter and more fun. With AI analysis and multi-device support, every jump counts and is easy to track.
en.disclaimerText: Training suggestions in this app are for reference only. Please exercise according to your own condition.
